Meet SORA

Hi, I am Sora. I am a sweet, happy and cuddly rescue dog living in a foster home in Belgium looking for my forever family. I have a kind, friendly and gentle character and I love nothing more than spending time with my foster parents, learning about the world and discovering what it means to be loved and cared for. They say that I am curious and smart and that I am the most loving dog. We enjoy every moment we can cuddle together and be in each other’s company. I am also active and enjoy a good run in the garden, being playful and having a good time.

I settled in quickly when I flew from Cyprus to my foster home at the beginning of September sleeping through the night and knowing when it is time for some rest after an eventful day. There are also resident dogs who I get along with well. I am always happy to meet new people and dogs and my tail never stops wagging.

There is not much I can share about my past. I was abandoned with my puppies and luckily we were taken in at a shelter in Cyprus. All my puppies have found a home and now it is my turn to find a family and start a new life full of joy, adventures and love.

Good with cats 🐱 | Good with dogs 🐶

House-trained ✔ Lead trained  ✔

You can find more photos and videos of SORA on our Facebook page
